name: Jack's Point Golf Club
description: Spectacular lakeside links set between the jagged Remarkables mountain range and the shores of Lake Wakatipu. Consistently ranked among the top five courses in New Zealand, the layout delivers dramatic elevation changes and panoramic alpine scenery on virtually every hole.

name: The Hills Golf Club
description: An exclusive private course built on a former deer farm in the Arrowtown hills, known for its large-scale outdoor sculptures scattered across the property. The Hills has hosted the NZ PGA Championship and attracts some of the country's strongest tournament fields.

name: Millbrook Resort (Coronet)
description: Designed by Sir Bob Charles, New Zealand's only major championship winner, this alpine resort course has served as a regular host of the New Zealand Open. The Coronet nine at Millbrook weaves through mature trees and water features against a stunning mountain backdrop.

name: Millbrook Resort (Remarkables)
description: The newer nine at Millbrook Resort, offering wide fairways framed by spectacular views of the Remarkables mountain range. Together with the Coronet nine, it completes one of the most scenic 18-hole resort experiences in the South Island.

name: Arrowtown Golf Club
description: A charming course threaded through the valleys below the historic gold-mining town of Arrowtown. Mature deciduous trees line the fairways, making autumn rounds particularly memorable, and the relaxed atmosphere suits golfers of all abilities.

name: Queenstown Golf Club
description: Set on the Kelvin Heights peninsula, this course is surrounded on three sides by Lake Wakatipu with sweeping views of the Remarkables, Cecil Peak, and Walter Peak. It is one of the most photographed golf settings in New Zealand.

name: Wanaka Golf Club
description: A scenic parkland layout beside Lake Wanaka with views stretching to the snow-capped peaks of Mt Aspiring National Park. The course suits all levels and provides a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere in one of the South Island's most popular lakeside towns.

name: Dunedin Golf Club (Balmacewen)
description: Dunedin's premier private club, Balmacewen features a well-maintained parkland layout with tree-lined fairways on gently rolling terrain. It is one of the strongest clubs in the Otago region and has hosted numerous provincial championships.

name: Otago Golf Club
description: One of Dunedin's established parkland clubs, offering a mature tree-lined layout with well-kept greens. A solid test of golf in a traditional setting within easy reach of the city centre.

name: Chisholm Links Golf Club
description: A links-style course perched beside St Clair Beach on the Dunedin coast, where sea breezes add an extra dimension to every round. The ocean views and accessible location make it a popular choice for visitors exploring the city.

name: Lake Hawea  Golf Club
description: A relaxed, family-friendly 9-hole course near Albert Town, just ten minutes from Wanaka. Built in 2001 near the shores of Lake Hawea, the course welcomes casual drop-in play with no tee-time bookings required.

name: Lower Waitaki Golf Club
description: A welcoming par-72 course on the flat plains near the mouth of the Waitaki River, 12 km north of Oamaru. Easy-flowing greens and well-tended fairways make it a pleasant round, and the friendly membership adds to the experience.

name: Omarama Golf Club
description: A pleasant, flat 9-hole course in the "place of light," bounded by the Omarama Stream with fine mountain views in every direction. The clever clover-leaf design brings players past the clubhouse every three holes, perfectly placed for a refreshment stop on a Central Otago summer day.

name: Owaka Golf Club
description: A 9-hole course along the banks of the Owaka River in the Catlins, surrounded by lush Otago countryside. The remote southern location and peaceful setting make it an appealing detour for golfers exploring the Catlins coast.

name: Taieri Lakes Golf Club
description: An 18-hole course at the base of Three Mile Hill in North Taieri, just 15 minutes from central Dunedin. The layout makes good use of the surrounding lake and hill terrain to create an engaging round close to the city.

name: Tapanui Golf Club
description: An 18-hole course on the northern edge of Tapanui in West Otago, featuring a newly refurbished clubhouse. The rural setting along State Highway 90 provides a pleasant backdrop for a full round in this quiet farming district.

name: Tokarahi Golf Club
description: A beautifully maintained 9-hole course in the Maerewhenua Valley of North Otago, climbing to 280 metres above sea level. From the upper holes, panoramic views stretch across to the Kakanui Mountains, St Marys Range, and the Waitaki Valley.

name: Barley Station Golf Course
description: A private course on the Crown Terrace near Queenstown, designed by former touring professional Greg Turner. Originally built on a farm owned by America's Cup legend Sir Russell Coutts, the layout takes advantage of the dramatic Central Otago landscape.

name: Clinton Golf Club
description: A friendly 9-hole course in the South Otago township of Clinton, established in 1937. Rolling hills and farmland surround the layout, providing a peaceful setting for a casual round.

name: Frankton Golf Centre
description: A gentle 9-hole course nestled beneath the dramatic backdrop of the Remarkables, ideally suited for beginners and families. Its convenient location next to Queenstown Airport and the Events Centre makes it an easy stop between flights.

name: Gladfield Country Golf Club
description: A relaxed 9-hole country course near Mosgiel on the Taieri Plain, just 15 minutes from Dunedin. Rolling countryside and well-groomed greens make it a pleasant spot for golfers of all abilities.

name: Glenorchy Golf Club
description: A unique 9-hole course in the tiny lakeside village of Glenorchy at the head of Lake Wakatipu. Surrounded by towering mountains and beech forest, it offers one of the most dramatic natural settings of any golf course in New Zealand.

name: Island Park Golf Club
description: A 9-hole parkland course in the Dunedin suburb of Waldronville, enjoying its own sheltered microclimate just 15 minutes from the CBD. The compact layout offers a genuine golfing challenge in a relaxed, family-friendly environment.

name: Kurow Golf Club
description: A pleasant 9-hole course in the heart of the beautiful Waitaki Valley, surrounded by the tussock-covered hills and big skies of the North Otago high country. A friendly stop for golfers travelling between Christchurch and Queenstown.

name: Lawrence Golf Club
description: Established in 1894, this is one of the oldest golf clubs in New Zealand. The flat, easy-walking 9-hole layout near the historic gold-rush town of Lawrence features ornamental trees and elevated tees with views across the Tuapeka countryside.

name: Middlemarch Golf Club
description: A 9-hole course on the edge of the Middlemarch township in the Strath Taieri Valley. The layout stretches over 5,650 metres and provides an enjoyable challenge for visitors exploring the Otago Central Rail Trail region.

name: Otematata Golf Club
description: A compact 9-hole course in the lakeside village of Otematata, conveniently located in the centre of town. It offers a casual round amid the expansive scenery of the upper Waitaki Basin.

name: Gibbston Valley Golf Club
description: Queenstown's newest golf club, featuring a 9-hole par-32 layout designed by former touring professional Greg Turner within the Gibbston Valley Resort. The course includes inventive double greens and is framed by the vineyard-studded hills of the Gibbston wine region.

name: Ardleigh Golf Club
description: A 9-hole course near Palmerston in Otago.

name: Belleknowes Golf Club
description: A friendly club in the heart of Dunedin with spectacular views of the city, harbour and out to sea. Surrounded by one of only three Victorian botanic gardens in the southern hemisphere.

name: Maniototo Golf Club
description: A 9-hole course in Ranfurly in the Maniototo plains of Central Otago.

name: St Clair Golf Club
description: A championship 18-hole course with world-class sea views. Signature hole 15 sits right on the coastline, a popular photo spot.

name: Twelve Oaks Golf Club
description: A 9-hole course near Mosgiel in the Taieri Plains.

name: Waitoa Park Golf Club
description: A 9-hole course in the Deborah area near Oamaru.

name: Heriot Golf Club
description: A picturesque 9-hole course in the heart of West Otago, featuring well-groomed greens and gently rolling fairways lined with mature trees. The friendly rural club welcomes visitors to this quiet corner of the Otago countryside.

name: Kaitangata Golf Club
description: A beginner-friendly 9-hole course in South Otago, set alongside Wangaloa Beach just 20 minutes from Balclutha. The coastal setting and welcoming club atmosphere make it a relaxed spot for a casual round.

name: Omakau Golf Club
description: A delightful 9-hole country course right in the centre of the South Island, bordered by the Otago Central Rail Trail. Every hole reveals new views of the surrounding schist-rock landscape that is so distinctive to Central Otago.

name: Otakou Golf Club
description: A 9-hole links-style course on the Otago Peninsula with a layout of humps, hollows, and contoured greens overlooking the harbour. The honesty-box format and exposed coastal setting give it an authentic, old-school New Zealand golf feel.

name: Allan Grange Golf Club
description: A pleasant 9-hole country course near Balclutha in South Otago, set along the Clutha River. The rolling farmland setting and well-kept fairways offer a relaxing round amid the quiet Otago countryside.

name: Port Chalmers Golf Club
description: A scenic 9-hole course blessed with sweeping views across the Otago Harbour. The club is renowned for its friendly, welcoming atmosphere and provides an enjoyable challenge for seasoned players and newcomers alike.

name: Toko Golf Club
description: A pleasant rolling 9-hole course in the South Otago town of Milton, about 40 minutes south of Dunedin. The layout is open to visitors and provides a genuine country-club atmosphere.

name: Waikouaiti Golf Club
description: A welcoming 9-hole country course near the beach, with panoramic views of a lagoon teeming with birdlife. Different tee blocks for the front and back nines give each loop a distinct character.

name: North Otago Golf Club
description: Well-maintained North Otago club in the Victorian whitestone city.

name: Cromwell Golf Club
description: A visitor-friendly club surrounded by the mountains and orchards of the Cromwell Basin in Central Otago. The dramatic landscape and dry climate make it a reliable year-round golfing destination.

name: Alexandra Golf Club
description: A parkland course set in the fruit-growing heartland of Alexandra, where Central Otago's hot summers and golden autumns create ideal playing conditions. The layout is well suited to visitors touring the region's vineyards and cycle trails.

name: Balclutha Golf Club
description: The main club in South Otago, serving the town of Balclutha and the wider Clutha district. A straightforward, well-kept course that provides a solid round for travellers heading south.

name: Naseby Golf Club
description: A historic course in the former gold-field village of Naseby, perched at 600 metres above sea level on the Maniototo Plain. The crisp high-country air and unique sub-alpine setting make it one of the more memorable 9-hole experiences in Otago.

name: Tarras Golf Club
description: An authentic rural club where sheep share the fairways and green fees go into an honesty box. Tarras sits on the main route between Wanaka and Cromwell, offering a quintessentially New Zealand golfing detour.

name: Ranfurly Golf Club
description: A rural Maniototo course in the small town of Ranfurly, known for its art deco architecture. The flat, open layout and big Central Otago skies make it a fitting stop for cyclists on the nearby Otago Central Rail Trail.

name: Kaka Point Golf Club
description: A remote coastal 9-hole near the wildlife-rich Catlins region, where penguins and sea lions are never far away. The rugged southern coastline provides a dramatic backdrop for a casual seaside round.

name: Dunstan Golf Club
description: Compact 9-hole in the historic gold-rush town of Clyde.

name: Roxburgh Golf Club
description: A remote 9-hole course in the Clutha Valley near the town of Roxburgh, surrounded by stone-fruit orchards and rolling farmland. It provides a quiet, unhurried round in one of Central Otago's most picturesque river valleys.

name: Palmerston Golf Club
description: A small rural 9-hole in the North Otago town of Palmerston, offering a friendly community atmosphere. The course is a convenient stop for travellers on State Highway 1 between Dunedin and Oamaru.

name: Duntroon Golf Club
description: A remote 9-hole in the Waitaki Valley near the Vanished World fossil trail and striking limestone formations. The rugged North Otago landscape lends the course a distinctive, almost otherworldly character.
